definitions.gloss: change (formal); small change returned to a customer
definitions.explanation: The money given back to a customer when they pay more than the amount owed. A formal alternative to the everyday お{釣|つ}り, commonly seen on receipts, signs, and in business contexts.

examples.japanese: {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}った→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
「{釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お{願|ねが}いします」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてあった→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: It said, 'Please pay the exact amount (no change required).'

examples.japanese: ⟦{自動販売機|じどうはんばいき}→自動販売機：03078_jidouhanbaiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故障|こしょう}して→故障する：01826_koshousuru⟧、{釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧こなかった。
examples.english: The vending machine broke down and didn't give back any change.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧ (from ⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧, originally a verb of pulling) + {銭|せん} (small money). The everyday spoken word for the same thing is ⟦お{釣|つ}り→お釣り：00878_otsuri⟧; {釣|つ}り{銭|せん} appears more on signs, receipts, and in formal speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}す→渡す：02442_watasu⟧: to hand over the change
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}らす: to run out of change
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: please pay the exact amount
- {釣|つ}り{銭|せん}⟦{機|き}→〜機：09843_ki⟧: change machine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦お{釣|つ}り→お釣り：00878_otsuri⟧: change (everyday/spoken)
- ⟦{小銭|こぜに}→小銭：02759_kozeni⟧: small change; coins (the coins themselves, not specifically money returned)
